title: Schema edge rules accept any spelling and the authored spelling is retained
summary: A `@schema` edges rule may be written with the active, inverse or present spelling of a predicate and carries its direction; an unknown spelling is refused with every accepted spelling listed, and compliance counts inbound rules against the edges whose active target is the record. Authored compiled edges and graph assertions keep the spelling the author wrote; the vocabulary catalogue and ia vocabulary show it. The frozen MACHINE_PROTOCOL version 1 operations of the @inventarch/runtime Door, the CLI machine routes and the MCP tools ia_get, ia_records, ia_traverse and ia_context answer an edge and an edge assertion without it, as 1.1.0 did, so their wire output, context's envelope estimate included, is unchanged. Editor completion of a relationship target applies only the schema rules written in the direction of the line's spelling. No record changes.
